name: fault-tree
description: Evaluate and improve Fault Tree drawings — how component failures combine into a top-level failure
goal: Reach a consistent 16+/20, with every node connected and drawn from a FAULT_M.VSSX master

prompts.text: Build a fault tree for a website outage, with the top event decomposed into hosting, network and application causes
Build a fault tree for data loss, decomposing into backup failure and storage failure branches
Build a fault tree for a failed payment, separating customer-side, gateway and bank causes
